subject: Access audit kit for SCIM/SSO/RBAC - request and timeline
messages:
From: Rajesh Singh <rajesh@medsafe.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: it-compliance@medsafe.io
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Access audit kit for upcoming SOC2 + SIG review

Vanessa —

We have a SIG and SOC 2 readiness review with our procurement and security teams next week (Dec 17). To complete our internal checklist we need a concise access/IAM bundle showing how Redwood handles SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC role definitions, and examples demonstrating least-privilege enforcement.

Specifically can you provide:
- current SAML metadata and a sample assertion (or anonymized assertion)
- a recent SCIM delta sync log (last 30 days) and SCIM configuration snapshot
- RBAC role matrix (roles -> permissions) and a short description of permission boundaries
- any automated attestations or access review cadence notes

We prefer a single archive if possible; otherwise a checklist + files is fine. Also let us know if you need an NDA/PO executed before sending anything marked as sensitive.

Thanks —
Rajesh Singh
IT Compliance
MedSafe Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Singh <rajesh@medsafe.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Access audit kit for upcoming SOC2 + SIG review

Rajesh —

Thanks for the heads up and the clear checklist. We can assemble a compact "access audit kit" for you by EOD Monday (Dec 13) that includes all items you listed. Quick notes / ask from us so we prepare exactly what you need: 

1) SAML / SSO
- We'll include our current production SAML metadata (signed XML) and a sanitized example of a SAML assertion.
- If you need raw assertions instead of sanitized samples, we can route via DocuSign NDA first. Please advise.

2) SCIM provisioning
- We'll export a 30-day delta sync (anonymized IDs) and a SCIM config snapshot showing mapping rules and claims.

3) RBAC and least privilege
- Attached: rbac-role-matrix-2026-12-10.xlsx (role -> permission, owner, last reviewed). We'll also include a one-page summary of permission boundaries and the automated enforcement hooks.

4) Access reviews / attestations
- Short write-up of our quarterly access review cadence and evidence (who signed off / dates).

Deliverables and timeline we propose:
- Dec 13 (EOD): ZIP with SAML metadata, sanitized assertion, SCIM delta CSV, RBAC matrix, and access-review summary.
- If you need the un-sanitized assertion or expanded logs, we'll need an executed NDA first; we can share a DocuSign link.

Attachments in the outgoing ZIP will be named clearly; I'm also sharing two links (Confluence checklist + secure Drive folder) so you can drop comments.

Do you want us to include any specific user accounts or service accounts in the SCIM sample (e.g., admin/service-account types)?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Singh <rajesh@medsafe.io>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Access audit kit for upcoming SOC2 + SIG review

Vanessa / Rajesh —

Looping in details from the infra side. We prepared the following preliminary items (attached as stubs below):

- [attachment: scim-delta-20261209.csv] -> contains anonymized user UUIDs, timestamped sync events, and attribute diffs (email, displayName, entitlements). We stripped PII per our standard process.
- [attachment: rbac-role-matrix-2026-12-10.xlsx] -> full role list, permission buckets, which routes/models each role can call, and last-review owner column.
- SCIM config: mapping includes externalId -> user.id, groups -> entitlements; provisioning: create/update/disable flows; delta window: 72h default for event-based syncs, full sync run weekly.

A few operational notes you might find useful for evidence:
- Provisioning runs are logged to our secure audit store with HSM-backed timestamps; export samples will include checksum headers.
- SSO (SAML) assertions are validated against our metadata fingerprint and accepted clock skew is 120s; we store verification logs for 90 days by default and can extend on request.
- RBAC: we enforce least privilege via permission scopes scoped at route/model level; elevated roles require multi-owner approval in the console.

If you'd like, we can include a short anonymized assertion example inline in the bundle. That will show the NameID format and the attribute mappings we emit.

-Neha Kapoor
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: scim-delta-20261209.csv]
[attachment: rbac-role-matrix-2026-12-10.xlsx]

From: Rajesh Singh <rajesh@medsafe.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 15:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Access audit kit for upcoming SOC2 + SIG review

Thanks — this looks good. Two quick follow-ups: 

1) Please include the SAML metadata + sanitized assertion in the ZIP. That should be sufficient for our SIG review. If we need raw assertions we will request an NDA; for now sanitized is OK.

2) Can you add a brief note about how you handle emergency role elevation (who approves, TTL, and audit logging)? That's an item procurement flagged.

We'll review the ZIP when it arrives on Dec 13 and let you know if we need deeper logs. If possible, please upload the bundle to the Drive folder you linked and post a note here with the share link.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Rajesh
IT Compliance | MedSafe Health
